crossRefs.note: Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ…
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a…
For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his…
For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

translations.web: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.
translations.bsb: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.
